vulnerability_behavior.preconditions_for_vulnerability: Improper handling of box data during parsing in the JP2 format.

vulnerability_behavior.specific_code_behavior_causing_vulnerabi: The code does not properly reset the box operations when an error occurs during the copying of box data. This can result in the `jp2_box_destroy` function attempting to destroy uninitialized or corrupted box data, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to reset the box operations to the default unknown box operations when an error occurs during the copying of box data. This ensures that any subsequent attempts to destroy the box do not rely on potentially uninitialized or corrupted data, thus preventing the NULL pointer dereference. In this case, the solution involves adding a line to reset the box operations to the default unknown box operations before continuing with the error handling process.
